$comment: Schema for a Privacy-Vision-Agent language pack (utils/i18n/packs/*.json). This is the contract that lets adding a language be a pure data contribution — drop a new file here that satisfies this schema, run build-language-packs.js, and it's live. No JavaScript changes required. Enforced by build-language-packs.js's validatePack(), which has no third-party dependency (ajv, zod, etc.) on purpose, so this stays a zero-install, copy-the-repo-and-run tool.

meta.langTag: BCP-47 language tag, e.g. 'hi-IN', 'mr-IN', 'ta-IN'. Used as both the registry key and SpeechSynthesisUtterance.lang.
meta.label: Short (1-4 glyph) label shown on the in-page language-toggle button, in the target language's own script (e.g. 'हिं' for Hindi, not 'HI').

entryFieldRules.title: Short field name (e.g. the field's proper noun, 2-6 words).
entryFieldRules.subtitle: One-line clarification of what the field/number is.
entryFieldRules.desc: 1-2 sentence instruction telling the user exactly what to type and where to find it.
entryFieldRules.hint: Short format reminder or safety note (e.g. 'no spaces', 'never sent to a server').

notes: 'generic' is the required fallback entry used whenever a field key has no dedicated translation (see i18nLabels.js's getTranslation()) — every pack must include it. All string values must be non-empty after trimming.
